blurb: Kuk Sool Won is a systematic study of all the traditional Asian fighting arts which, together, comprise the martial art history of Korea. This form of martial art was passed down through many generations of the Suh family and was founded as a traditional martial art system in 1958 by Grandmaster Suh In Hyuk.
